lines.text: The LORD will forgive Jerusalem if one just person is found, yet the people swear falsely and refuse to repent.
The speaker says he will go to the powerful, but they broke the yoke, so a bear will strike them.
The people say the LORD will do nothing, so He will make His words a flood in their mouths.
The LORD will bring a distant nation with an unknown language, and they will serve foreigners in a land not their own.
